heroHeadline: Oil Prices Surge as Saudi Aramco Attack Reports Add to Hormuz Shipping Crisis
heroSubtitle: Markets reacted to reports of a Saudi Aramco attack and escalating Hormuz shipping risks, as Houthi attacks continue compounding US-Iran diplomatic pressure on regional energy supply routes
